title: Dual-modification of biochar via Fenton oxidation and in situ α-FeOOH synthesis for enhanced Cu(II) removal: experimental investigation and theoretical calculation analysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44961-44973
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05887B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wei Yang, Ziguo Liu, Qingkun Liu, Qingbin Sun, Han Zheng, Jiancheng Hu
An innovative composite adsorbent from bamboo biochar was successfully synthesized by dual-modification of Fenton oxidation and surface generation of α-FeOOH and exhibited highly efficient Cu(II) adsorption.
